name: Design Cart Migration
author: Paweł Nosko

sections.description:
Design Cart Migration helps move a WordPress site to a new domain:

  • Export SQL — enter the new site URL and download a full database dump with addresses already replaced (including serialized PHP and common URL variants).
  • Live replace — on an already imported database, replace old URL with new URL safely (serialized data aware).

Full documentation (Polish): Migracja WordPressa i WooCommerce na inny serwer – Design Cart Migration

Author: Paweł Nosko / Design Cart.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Open Migration in the admin menu
  4. Choose Export SQL or Live replace
